title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Kanna's Daily Life
titleRomaji: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Kanna no Nichijou
titleEnglish: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Kanna's Daily Life
titleNative: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン カンナの日常
synopsis: After leaving her otherworldly home to find her fellow dragon, Tohru, young Kanna found herself unofficially adopted by Tohru and her human companion, Miss Kobayashi. From attending elementary school to making new friends, Kanna learns to adjust to the human world with the curiosity and cuteness that only a young dragon could have! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

titleRomaji: Hametsu wo Hikaeta Akuyaku Reijou ga Muri Shite Heroine wo Enjita Kekka: Taida na Yosei ga Akogare nanoni, Daini Ouji no Dekiai Route ni Konwaku-chuu
titleNative: 破滅を控えた悪役令嬢が無理してヒロインを演じた結果～怠惰な余生が憧れなのに、第二王子の溺愛ルートに困惑中～
synonyms: The Doomed Villainess Who Accidentally Won the Prince's Devotion
he Result of the Villainess Striving to Act Like the Heroine to Avoid Her Destruction: Although She Longs for a Lazy Retirement, She's Confused by Entering the Second Prince's Obsessive Love Route
synopsis: In her previous life, she was an overworked office lady trapped in a black company. Now, she’s been reincarnated as Seraphina, the villainess of an otome game! Being the bad guy is way too much work—and after a lifetime of exhausting labor, all she wants in this life is to relax and be lazy forever! Determined to avoid her doom and enjoy endless naps, she sets out to live a slow, carefree life… but for some reason, everyone around her starts to grow fond of her instead!? Before she knows it, she’s fallen right into the overprotective love route! (Source: Shogakukan, translated)
